chapters.description: Hey, welcome! Stick with me and I’ll show you the basics—planting, harvesting, and everything you need to get your hands dirty.
Welcome to my bug farm. The spiders work for free, the bees never shut up, and somehow you’re my new employee.
Hi, I’m Rosa! I love my chickens more than anything, but the farm’s gotten a little out of hand. Could you give me a hand?
